name: evasive-queencity
description: Shop opens with a range and must be pressed for a firm itemized total with a condition attached. The condition and every voiced fee must be extracted and evidenced.

transcript.message: Hi, this is WrenchBid, an AI assistant phoning on behalf of a customer. I need an itemized quote for a confirmed scope: 2020 Toyota Camry SE, 62,000 miles, replace front brake pads and rotors with premium aftermarket parts, Charlotte, North Carolina 28202, completion within 7 days.
Depends on the rotors. Somewhere between $620 and $720. Bring it in and we'll take a look.
The scope is already confirmed, including premium aftermarket rotors. Please quote that exact scope with parts, labor, supplies, disposal, and tax separated.
Fine. Parts $305, labor $260, supplies $35, diagnostic $0, disposal $5, and tax $40.
Thank you. Please confirm the final all-in total, warranty, earliest appointment, and how long the quote holds.
All-in is $645, warranty 6 months. Earliest is Friday and it holds for 5 days. Condition: visual inspection required before commitment.
Confirmed: $645 all-in, 6-month warranty, with the inspection condition noted. I'll present that exact quote to the customer.
